blocks.text: SHANGHAI, China — Huawei rejected a US conviction finding the Chinese tech giant guilty of stealing trade secrets, calling the verdict baseless and threatening legal action on Wednesday. The US charges are “without legal or factual merit,” Huawei said in a statement, adding that “we will thoroughly review the relevant verdicts and take all necessary legal actions to defend our rights and interests.” Huawei, the world’s leading telecommunications equipment manufacturer, was convicted in a New York federal court after a three-month trial.
